recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. No broader request-resource sweep is recommended because FHIR-11124 was specific to DiagnosticRequest and the generic Request pattern already carries signedOn; this fix only ensures the active successor resource preserves the seed alias.
issue_request: FHIR-11124 was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification. It asked whether DiagnosticRequest.authored should use a more generic/signed-oriented name, and the final resolution was to rename the element to authoredOn and add signed on as an alias.
initial_application: Commit 839bf586d6c1cf9a322e122852f0cc49bcfed263 included #11124 and changed the generic Request pattern from Request.authored to Request.authoredOn with aliases createdOn and signedOn. The retired DiagnosticRequest lineage later moved through ProcedureRequest into ServiceRequest.
additional_context: The current build no longer has DiagnosticRequest as an active resource; source/fhir.ini lists ServiceRequest as active and DiagnosticRequest as removed. FHIR-11119 and the related Zulip thread confirm DiagnosticRequest and ProcedureRequest were combined, and later git history renamed ProcedureRequest to ServiceRequest. The current Request pattern already retains signedOn, but ServiceRequest.authoredOn only retained orderedOn before this reconciliation.
reconciliation: Added <alias value="signedOn"/> to source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml under ServiceRequest.authoredOn. The file is current build scope through the active ServiceRequest resource entry, and the hunk is limited to the active successor element.
source_changes: source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml: Added signedOn as an alias on ServiceRequest.authoredOn.

related_jiras.note: Request-resource harmonization supplied the Request pattern that FHIR-11124 updated.
Combined DiagnosticRequest and ProcedureRequest, establishing the lineage that is now ServiceRequest.
